summary: Two-week window (8/28-9/11), and the account finally moved on the thing it had been stuck on for 42 days — while the money side quietly got worse. THE ENGINE STARTED: Fred sent the Notion invite on 8/31, and once Shayna could see the board she cleared a backlog nobody had been driving. She reversed her own position on the $4,700 live rather than lose it — 'I can get these lives done next week' (9/4) — and asked Fred to canvass fans for the 8th, 9th and 10th. On 9/9 he produced the most concrete piece of work on this account all quarter: a fan-by-fan availability list with status for five fans, then added the schedules to Notion. He also asked approval AND a price before selling, twice (9/8 custom at $500, 9/10 dick rate at $400) — the standing 4/15 instruction, followed with the price attached, for the first time. BUT VISIBILITY KEEPS FINDING HOLES. That same 9/9 list revealed that Jason (@u415682280), who paid $1,000 in full for a 1:1 live on 2026-07-07, is now 'not interested in the live anymore' — 66 days later, with no refund or substitute discussed by anyone — and that Manuel (@u20689003), who paid $600 on 2026-05-22, has gone unresponsive at 112 days. Add the $4,700 VIP DEE live, still unscheduled at window close, and ALTR is holding roughly $6,300 of fan money against three undelivered lives. She also caught four separate fans missing from or stale on the Notion board in nine days, and when she flagged the stale ones on 9/1 Fred's answer was to hand her the job: 'If any are done you should be able to edit the status on the page'. AND THE INVOICE WENT QUIET. Stephski issued the Aug 15-31 invoice on 9/1 with 7-day terms and has not sent a single message since. It is 3 days past due at window close with no payment signal from Shayna, no chase from ALTR, and the Aug 1-14 payment she completed unaided on 8/26 still unacknowledged at 16 days. That is the exact condition (unconfirmed transfers on new bank rails) under which she halted payment mid-installment on 7/5. Elsewhere: Fred apologised for late responses for the 5th dated time on 9/8 ('I've been moving so time's been scarce'), Mayson had to @-tag him 6 times in 14 days to get answers, the monthly check-in call agreed on 8/28 has still never happened at 14 days, the 7/28 freeloader-blocking instruction resurfaced at 41 days when she found a fan of 5 years with zero spend, and Mica has now sent nothing in 29 days. Michelle delivered on-time leak reports on 9/1 and 9/8 (10th and 11th consecutive) and was thanked both times. Client tone is still genuinely warm — 'No worries moving sucks hope it’s going okay!' (9/8).
